core_thesis: A node pool's spec sheet is not the capacity a team can promise, because the scheduler advertises memory minus a provider-set reserve and an eviction buffer.
core_conflict: Advertised node capacity versus allocatable memory; GKE's 24% reserve against AKS's 8% on the same 8 GiB node, plus the kernel's throttle point below the limit.
